name: PROTER
description: Proter is a card game commonly played with 2-6 using 52 cards. The core rules emphasize variant-specific tactical timing, legal action sequencing, and scoring control.

content.text: Proter is a card game commonly played with 2-6 using 52 cards. The core rules emphasize variant-specific tactical timing, legal action sequencing, and scoring control.

Country/Region of Origin: Sri Lanka. Proter is a Rummy game played in Sri Lanka. Time Period: Documented from late 1990s onward.
Historical Development: A form of rummy with a different wild card in each of 13 deals.
Cultural Significance: Popular card game in Sri Lanka.
